fused_deltas.finding: Loop control requires at least state dynamics + unresolved pressure + verified marginal utility/outcome. Numerical convergence alone can hide overthinking.

Snapshot/root-bound effect commit plus explicit serialization conflict/retry removed all tested stale/mixed-state decisions in 1400 guarded runs; program semantic identity and execution/replay identity must remain separate.

Dependency-scoped effect validation dominates stale permit reuse in the constructed model and avoids false aborts caused by unrelated state churn: exact read-set identity + current capability epoch/validity is the strongest current candidate commit envelope; whole-ledger CAS remains a live counterhypothesis for a simple serialized H1.

Per-mode stability does not imply schedule-family stability. Individually stable operators can become strongly amplifying under legal switching; jitter/schedule class must be a robustness surface for coupled Frank loops.

Recurrence continuation, controller gain, retries and stagnation must never widen effect authority. Recurrent effect receipts need episode/attempt/cumulative-budget/capability/denial/rollback identity.

integrated_model.summary: Current strongest synthesis: a loop-of-loops Frank whose recurrence is outcome-aware, whose authoritative state/effects are transaction/dependency-envelope bound, whose program semantics are separated from dynamic execution identity, whose effect authority cannot amplify through recurrence, and whose coupled timing is validated over jitter/schedule families. Compiler frontend determinism is a prerequisite for all higher-level identity guarantees.
invariants: frontend parse determinism precedes semantic identity claims
